quotes.text: Planner is a task management solution. It does that very well. All tasks live in planner. And that will be the future of what Microsoft has seen, right? At least how I envisioned that. But it's not an enterprise project management solution.

quotes.text: And start from a no permission mindset, zero permission mindset, right? The AI should have a zero permission access from day one and build from that.

takeaways: Microsoft Planner is an excellent task management tool, but enterprise project and portfolio management needs program, portfolio, financial, risk and lessons-learned layers on top.
The Power Platform with Dataverse, Power Apps, Power Automate and Power BI provides the flexible foundation for building and tailoring enterprise PPM solutions such as Projectum xPM.
AI can draft documents, surface lessons learned and act as a PMO assistant, but project managers stay accountable and AI access should start from a zero-permission mindset.
hook: Many organizations manage hundreds of projects with Planner, Excel and scattered tools but lack a real portfolio view of resources, budgets and risks. This episode is for PMO leaders, project managers and Power Platform makers. Microsoft MVP Erik van Hurck explains how Planner, the Power Platform and AI come together to build enterprise project and portfolio management.
